_comment: Delving Deeper -> Arena monster mapping. One entry per Arena row (or per expansion group). 'dd' is the qualified name in tables.json summary; 'source' overrides where a detail table is used. Fields not given are derived from tables.json by generate.py (see mapping.md for the derivation rules). 'unmapped' lists DD abilities with no Arena code (collected into NOTES.md); 'crit' records the exceeds-by-4-or-natural-20 damage pattern; 'trigger' records the same pattern used as a non-damage trigger.

monsters.name: Android
notes: Align 'Any' -> N. 'Mind powers equivalent to magic use of up to 4th level' on d6-2 per android (2/3 have them, mean level 2.5) -> Spells (2) as a typical individual.

monsters.name: Giant Ant
unmapped: Secondary move 3 is burrowing (no Arena code).
Never flee the nest while the queen lives (lair-only).

monsters.name: Ape
unmapped: Secondary move 12 is climbing (no Arena code).

monsters.name: Basilisk
notes: Gaze or touch petrifies (save vs petrification): same pair as master Basilisk.

monsters.name: Bat
notes: 'Mostly harmless': Atk 0 / Dam 0 as master does for Shrieker.
unmapped: Startled colony obscures sight, drops torches, interrupts spellcasting.

monsters.name: Giant Bat
unmapped: Surprise on 3+ on d6 (master would write Stealth (n), not an enum name).
Shriek makes normal-types cover ears for one turn.

notes: HD 2-7 is a range: one row per HD value.
No damage stated -> default 1d6 for every size.
unmapped: Secondary move 6 is tunnelling through soft earth.

monsters.name: Black Pudding
notes: Dissolves wood and metal armor -> WoodEating, MetalEating. Invulnerable to cold -> ColdImmunity. Lightning and slashing divide it harmlessly -> VoltImmunity, ChopImmunity (master Black Pudding uses the same set).
unmapped: Splitting into smaller puddings (master writes Splitting, not an enum name).
Susceptible to fire (no vulnerability stated beyond being harmable).

monsters.name: Boar
unmapped: One more attack roll after being reduced to 0 hp.

monsters.name: Giant Boar
notes: 'Will never retreat' -> Fearlessness.
unmapped: One more attack roll after being reduced to 0 hp.

monsters.name: Cave Bear
unmapped: One more attack roll after being reduced to 0 hp.

monsters.name: Caveman
unmapped: -1 morale (master writes Cowardice, not an enum name).

monsters.name: Centaur
notes: Two attack rolls (weapon and hooves) -> Atk 2. Align 'L, N' -> L. Treasure A1 -> A.

monsters.name: Giant Centipede
notes: AC 3/7 (armored head / soft body) -> 3, the head a fighter faces. Bite paralyses with a save -> Paralysis.
unmapped: Split AC: body is AC 7 (Arena has one AC).
Moves on walls and ceilings at full speed.

monsters.name: Large Centipede
notes: Paralysis save is at +4 for large centipedes; Arena's Paralysis takes no save-modifier parameter (only Poison does), so the +4 is lost.
No damage stated -> default 1d6 (master gives its tiny centipede Dam 0).

monsters.name: Chimera
notes: Three heads -> Atk 3. 6" cone of fire for 3-18 -> FireBreath (3) (Arena: n dice of damage, cone length n). Same as master Chimera.

monsters.name: Cockatrice
notes: Touch petrifies (save vs petrification) -> Petrification on hit.

monsters.name: Crocodile
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4: drags victim into the water and drowns it
unmapped: Hard to spot half-submerged; often attacks by surprise.

monsters.name: Giant Crocodile
notes: Swallows man-sized victim whole on exceeds-by-4 -> Swallowing (Arena triggers it on a total attack roll of 25+, the closest analogue).
unmapped: Overturns boats and rafts; can be rammed by ships.

monsters.name: Cyborg
notes: 'Need never check morale' -> Fearlessness. Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Never give up a pursuit while quarry in sight.

monsters.name: Cyclops
notes: Hurls rocks up to 20" for 2-12 -> RockHurling (Arena: 2d6 rock). Poor depth perception -2 on attack rolls -> HitBonus (-2). Treasure E* -> E.

monsters.name: Deinonychus
unmapped: Stalks prey and never gives up pursuit while prey in sight.

monsters.name: Mosasaurus
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4 / natural 20: swallow whole (mapped to Swallowing)

notes: HD 2-7 is a range: one row per HD value. No damage stated -> default 1d6.

monsters.name: Stegosaurus
notes: AC 2/5: the plates give AC 2 only against attacks not from the flank; a surrounding party mostly flanks it, so 5 is used. Damage 3-8 normally.
unmapped: Split AC: AC 2 against attacks other than from the flank (Arena has one AC).
Tail spikes do 2-12 to flank or rear attackers.

monsters.name: Triceratops
notes: AC 2/5: frill and horns give AC 2 from the front; it charges head-on, so 2 is used.
unmapped: Split AC: AC 5 from other facings (Arena has one AC).
Charge does 4-24 instead of 2-12.

monsters.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4 / natural 20: swallow whole (mapped to Swallowing)

monsters.name: Djinni
notes: 1-11 damage -> 2d6-1 (as master Djinni). Becomes invisible -> Invisibility; phantasm-like illusions -> Illusion; whirlwind 2" wide -> Whirlwind (2) (parameter is width; master uses 1). Env X for extraplanar as in master.
unmapped: Gaseous form (master writes GasForm).
Object creation (master writes Creation).

monsters.name: Doppelganger
notes: Shape change -> Polymorphism. Saves as a 10th-level fighter -> SaveBonus (6), master's idiom for the identical OD&D text. Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Immune to sleep and charm.

monsters.name: Dragon Turtle
notes: Name ends in 'Dragon Turtle' so Arena adds the Dragon special itself (breath = hit points, random age category for hp). 9"x3" cone of scalding steam 'as a dragon's breath weapon' -> SteamBreath. No melee damage stated -> default 1d6.
unmapped: 50% chance to capsize a ship it surfaces under.

notes: Line of acid -> AcidBreath; invulnerable to acid -> AcidImmunity. All dragons: Detection (6), Fearlessness from Sub-Adult (DD adult), Fear (2) from Old (see mapping.md).
unmapped: Swims and breathes underwater indefinitely (no rate given).

notes: Line of lightning -> VoltBreath; invulnerable to lightning -> VoltImmunity.
unmapped: Buries itself in sand for ambush.

notes: Named 'Gold Dragon' (Arena's spelling) so Monster.java's Gold Dragon spell handling applies: bare 'Spells' makes Arena add two spells per level up to the age category, which tracks DD's 'as many spells as hit dice, up to 3rd level (6th for ancient goldens)' closely enough. Saves +4 vs magic -> SaveBonus (4). Sonic breath has no SpecialType: FireBreath used as a plain-damage stand-in (see NOTES).
unmapped: Breath is sound, not fire (also damages structures).
Cannot be subdued; polymorphs into human form.

notes: Cone of chlorine -> PoisonBreath.
unmapped: Immune to poison (no PoisonImmunity in SpecialType).

notes: Cone of fire -> FireBreath; invulnerable to fire -> FireImmunity.
Cone of cold -> ColdBreath; invulnerable to cold -> ColdImmunity.
unmapped: Swims and tunnels through snow and ice (no rates given).

monsters.name: Dryad
notes: Charm with save vs spells at -2 -> Charm (-2) (parameter is the target's save modifier), identical to master. Align 'L, N' -> L.
unmapped: Non-violent; bound within 24" of its tree.

monsters.name: Dwarf
notes: Ogres, trolls and giants do half damage to dwarfs -> DodgeGiants (Arena: -4 to hit by H-type monsters of 4+ HD), the master's code for the same OD&D rule. No save bonus in DD, so master's SaveBonus (4) is not carried over.
unmapped: Half damage from ogres/trolls/giants is modelled as a to-hit penalty, not a damage halving.

monsters.name: Efreeti
notes: Flies, invisibility, illusions, wall of fire -> Flight, Invisibility, Illusion, WallOfFire (all in master Efreeti).
unmapped: 'Become incendiaries' (immolation of self; no fire immunity stated).
Object creation (master writes Creation).

notes: HD 8/12/16 -> three rows. Move '-/36': flight only, so MV 36 plus Flight (36) as master does. 2-7 damage -> 1d6+1. Whirlwind 3" wide at base -> Whirlwind (3), as master. 'Elementals of any sort are affected by magical weapons only' (Elementals group introduction) -> MagicToHit (1); master uses (2), DD says any magic weapon.
unmapped: +2 to hit vs aerial opponents.
Whirlwind height grows with HD.

notes: 3-18 vs opponents on solid ground -> 3d6 (2-12 vs airborne not modelled). Magic weapons only (Elementals introduction) -> MagicToHit (1).
unmapped: Secondary move 6 is through earth; cannot cross water; move earth drives it back for 6-36.

notes: Summary table says HD 11+3 but the Explanation of Monsters gives 8/12/16 for all elementals; 8/12/16 used (see NOTES). 2-12 damage -> 2d6 (2-7 vs fire creatures not modelled). No fire immunity is stated, so none added. Magic weapons only (Elementals introduction) -> MagicToHit (1).
unmapped: Ignites inflammables; cannot cross water.

notes: 2-12 in water, 1-6 on land -> 2d6 (the in-water figure, as master). Magic weapons only (Elementals introduction) -> MagicToHit (1).
unmapped: Overturns boats; must stay within 6" of water.

monsters.name: Elf
notes: Align 'L, N' -> L.
unmapped: +1 damage with magic weapons.
Move silently / near-invisibly in woods (master writes Camouflage).
Leader-types with fighter/magic-user levels.

notes: HD 4-9 is a range: one row per HD value. Move '-/30': MV 0 plus Swimming (30), the master idiom for purely aquatic creatures.

monsters.name: Gargoyle
notes: 'Normal weapons do them no harm' -> MagicToHit (1), as master.
unmapped: Indistinguishable from statues; 75% hostile.

monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
notes: Contact paralyses (save) then 1-6/turn -> Paralysis, Dam 1d6. Invulnerable to cold and lightning -> ColdImmunity, VoltImmunity. Type S adds Slime (non-sentient, so immune to mental attacks). Treasure '*' (absorbed items) -> '-'.
unmapped: Immune to fear, paralysis and polymorph (fear/paralysis partly covered by Slime being non-sentient).

monsters.name: Ghoul
notes: Touch paralyses normal man-types 1 turn -> Paralysis. Type U adds Undead.
unmapped: -2 attack and morale in daylight.
Elves immune to the paralysis.
Slain man-types rise as ghouls (master writes Spawn).

monsters.name: Hill Giant
notes: Stats from Table 3.10. The Giants group introduction gives every giant rock hurling for 2-12 (RockHurling, Arena's rock is 2d6) and 'need never check morale against man-types' (Fearlessness).

monsters.name: Stone Giant
notes: Hurls rocks for 3-18 (2-12 for other giants) -> RockHurling (Arena's rock does 2d6). Fearlessness per the Giants introduction.

monsters.name: Frost Giant
notes: Invulnerable to cold -> ColdImmunity. 3-13 -> 2d6+1 (as master). RockHurling, Fearlessness per the Giants introduction.

monsters.name: Fire Giant
notes: Invulnerable to fire -> FireImmunity. 4-14 -> 2d6+2 (as master). RockHurling, Fearlessness per the Giants introduction.

monsters.name: Cloud Giant
notes: Keen smell, rarely surprised -> Detection (master's code for the same OD&D text). RockHurling, Fearlessness per the Giants introduction.

monsters.name: Storm Giant
notes: Hurls rocks -> RockHurling. Invulnerable to lightning -> VoltImmunity. 6-21 -> 3d6+3 (as master). Fearlessness per the Giants introduction.
unmapped: Weather control (master writes WeatherControl).
Lightning strike for 8-48 in thunderstorm conditions.

monsters.name: Gnoll
notes: Number 2-10 -> 2d5.
unmapped: +2 morale (master writes Bravery (2)).

monsters.name: Gnome
notes: Align 'L, N' -> L.

monsters.name: Goblin
notes: Treasure '*' (1-6 gp each) -> '-'.
unmapped: -1 attack and morale in full daylight (master writes LightSensitivity).

monsters.name: Clay Golem
notes: Only harmed by magic weapons -> MagicToHit (1). Name ends in Golem so Arena adds Golem. 'Largely invulnerable to harmful magic' (Golems introduction) -> MagicImmunity, as master; the few spells DD says do affect it are listed below.
unmapped: Hasted for three turns after one turn of combat.
Disintegrate slows it; move earth drives it back for 6-36.
Its wounds need a 9th-level cleric to cure.

monsters.name: Flesh Golem
notes: Only harmed by magic weapons -> MagicToHit (1). 'Largely invulnerable to harmful magic' (Golems introduction) -> MagicImmunity, as master.
unmapped: Slowed by cold and fire spells; healed by lightning.

monsters.name: Gorgon
notes: 6"x2" petrifying breath thrice per day -> PetrifyingBreath (as master). No melee damage stated -> 1d6.

monsters.name: Gothrog
notes: DD's balrog. Sword and whip on two targets for 2-12 each -> Atk 2, Dam 2d6. Fire and normal weapons cannot harm -> FireImmunity, MagicToHit (1). 75% spells fail -> MagicResistance (75). Whip-drag-and-immolate for 2-12 -> Immolation (master Balrog idiom). Never checks morale -> Fearlessness.
unmapped: +2 to hit when using a single weapon; sword alone does 3-18.
Cannot be subdued.

monsters.name: Gray Ooze
notes: Dissolves metal armor -> MetalEating; impervious to cold and fire -> ColdImmunity, FireImmunity (identical to master).

monsters.name: Green Slime
notes: Eats flesh, wood and metal -> FleshEating, WoodEating, MetalEating; impervious to lightning and blows -> VoltImmunity, ChopImmunity. Dam 0 because FleshEating carries the effect (same as master). Move 'n/a' -> 0.

monsters.name: Halfling
notes: Align 'L, N' -> L.
unmapped: +3 to hit with hurled missiles.
Move silently and hide superbly.

monsters.name: Hippogriff
unmapped: Never checks morale when defending its nest.

monsters.name: Hobgoblin
unmapped: +1 morale except in daylight, where -1 to hit (master writes Bravery (1)).

monsters.name: Destrier
notes: Stats from Table 3.11 (MV 15 there, 12 in the summary; the detail table wins). AC 7* (4 if barded) -> 7. 'Number' n/a -> 1.

monsters.name: Draft Horse
notes: 'Only warhorses and destriers will attack' -> Atk 0 / Dam 0.

monsters.name: Mule
notes: Does not attack -> Atk 0 / Dam 0. 'Only mules are agile enough to enter' a dungeon -> Env D.

monsters.name: Riding Horse
notes: Does not attack -> Atk 0 / Dam 0.

monsters.name: War Horse
notes: AC 7* (4 if barded) -> 7.
HD 5-12, one head per HD, one attack roll per head -> one row per HD, Atk = heads, ManyHeads (Arena's hydra idiom: max hit points, heads lost as damage accrues).
unmapped: Heads attack as a fighter rather than as a monster.

monsters.name: Invisible Stalker
notes: Move '-/12': flight only, so MV 12 plus Flight (12).
unmapped: Faultless tracker (master writes Tracking).

monsters.name: Juggernaut
notes: Only harmed by +3 weapons -> MagicToHit (3). 'Impervious to most magical attacks' -> MagicImmunity (closest code). Never checks morale -> Fearlessness. The jewel's slaying spell and improved hold person each turn -> Death and Hold: both are SpecialType names, but Monster.java only implements them as conditions, not as monster attacks, so they are documentation only (see NOTES).
unmapped: Slaying spell each turn (Death listed but inert).
Improved hold person on 2-12 man-types at -2, or one at -6 (Hold listed but inert).
Crushes anything in its path; cannot be subdued.

monsters.name: Kobold
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C. Treasure '*' -> '-'.
unmapped: -1 morale unless defending lair at 3:1 odds.

monsters.name: Giant Leech
notes: Attaches and drains one experience level the turn after attaching and every other turn after -> EnergyDrain (1) per hit is the closest code (master uses BloodDrain because OD&D leeches drain hp, but DD's drain levels).
unmapped: Attachment cadence (drain every other turn, not every hit).

monsters.name: Lion
unmapped: Stalks to attack by surprise (master writes Stealth (2)).

monsters.name: Iron Living Statue
notes: Golem added explicitly (name does not end in Golem) for construct behaviour. Only +3 weapons harm it -> MagicToHit (3). 1" cloud of poison gas -> PoisonBreath (1), master Iron Golem idiom. 'Largely invulnerable to harmful magic' (Living Statues introduction) -> MagicImmunity.
unmapped: Slowed by lightning; healed by fire.

monsters.name: Stone Living Statue
notes: Golem added explicitly. Slows one target per turn -> Slowing (master Stone Golem idiom). Only +2 weapons harm it -> MagicToHit (2). 'Largely invulnerable to harmful magic' (Living Statues introduction) -> MagicImmunity.
unmapped: Slowed by cold and fire; healed by stone to flesh.

monsters.name: Giant Lizard
monsters.trigger: natural 20: bite clamps on and does automatic damage each turn
unmapped: Superb camouflage (master writes Camouflage).

monsters.name: Large Lizard
unmapped: Superb camouflage.

monsters.name: Lizardman
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C.

monsters.name: Werebear
notes: Only silvered or magic weapons harm -> SilverToHit. Align 'L, N' -> L.
unmapped: Lycanthropy infection (master writes Lycanthropy).
Retaliate at +4 if young or females attacked.

monsters.name: Wereboar
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Lycanthropy infection.

monsters.name: Weretiger
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Lycanthropy infection.

monsters.name: Werewolf
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Lycanthropy infection.

monsters.name: Manticora
notes: DD spelling kept. Volley of 6 tail spikes within 18" -> TailSpikes (Arena: six 1d6 spike attacks), as master Manticore.

monsters.name: Mastodon
notes: Summary spells it 'Mastadons'; the description heading is 'Mastodons'.

monsters.name: Medusa
notes: Gaze petrifies -> PetrifyingGaze; hair of deadly venomous snakes -> Poison (as master).

monsters.name: Bandit
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C. Treasure A1 -> A.

monsters.name: Berserker
notes: +2 to hit vs man-types -> HitBonus (2); never checks morale -> Fearlessness (as master).
unmapped: The +2 applies only against man-types.

monsters.name: Brigand
unmapped: +1 morale (master writes Bravery (1)).

monsters.name: Buccaneer
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C. Treasure A3 -> A.

monsters.name: Dervish
notes: +2 to hit vs man-types and never checks morale -> HitBonus (2), Fearlessness. Treasure A2 -> A.
unmapped: The +2 applies only against man-types.

monsters.name: Mercenary
notes: Treasure A3 -> A.

monsters.name: Nomad
notes: Align 'C, N' -> C. Treasure A2 -> A.
unmapped: Always mounted.

monsters.name: Pirate
notes: Treasure A3 -> A.
unmapped: +1 morale.

monsters.name: Zealot
notes: As Dervish, chaotic. Treasure A2 -> A.
unmapped: The +2 applies only against man-types.

monsters.name: Merman
notes: Treasure A3 -> A.
unmapped: +2 to hit and no morale checks vs man-types in the sea; -2 to hit and morale on land (master writes LandWeakness).
Grapple ships (master writes Grappling).

monsters.name: Minotaur
notes: Never checks morale -> Fearlessness (as master). Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Never gives up a chase.

monsters.name: Mummy
notes: Invulnerable to normal weapons -> MagicToHit (1); magic weapons half damage -> ChopResistance (parameter 0 halves all weapon damage); vulnerable to fire -> FireVulnerability; necrosis slows healing tenfold -> Rotting. Identical to master Mummy.

monsters.name: Nixie
notes: Any 10 nixies jointly cast charm person -> CharmPerTen (as master).
unmapped: Water breathing on the charmed victim; grappling ships with 40+.

monsters.name: Ochre Jelly
notes: Dissolves wood -> WoodEating; lightning and weapons divide it harmlessly -> VoltImmunity, ChopImmunity (as master).
unmapped: Splitting into two jellies (master writes Splitting).

monsters.name: Giant Octopus
notes: 1-6 attack rolls per turn -> Atk 4 (expected value 3.5; Arena has no random attack rate). Move '-/9' -> MV 0 plus Swimming (9). Treasure A3 -> A.
unmapped: Grapple and capsize small vessels.

monsters.name: Ogre
notes: 3-8 -> 1d6+2. Treasure C* -> C.

monsters.name: Orc
unmapped: -1 attack and morale in full daylight (master writes LightSensitivity).
No morale checks defending lair at 3:1 odds.

monsters.name: Pegasus
notes: Align 'L, N' -> L.

monsters.name: Pixie
notes: Permanently invisible -> Invisibility. Any 10 pixies jointly cast sleep once per day -> Sleep: a SpecialType name, but Monster.java only implements it as a condition, so documentation only (see NOTES).
unmapped: Joint sleep spell once per day (Sleep listed but inert).
Always attack by surprise unless magically detected.

monsters.name: Purple Worm
notes: Swallows whole on exceeds-by-4 / 20 -> Swallowing; venomous tail stinger -> Poison; never checks morale -> Fearlessness (identical to master).
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4 / natural 20: swallow whole (mapped to Swallowing)
unmapped: Secondary move 9 is burrowing.

monsters.name: Giant Rat
notes: 1-3 -> 1d3 (as master).
unmapped: Disease on a hit, save vs poison at +4 (master writes Disease, not an enum name).
-2 morale; flee from fire.

monsters.name: Robot
notes: 3-8 -> 1d6+2. Never checks morale -> Fearlessness. Disintegration ray thrice per day (save vs wands) -> Disintegration: a SpecialType name, but only implemented as a condition in Monster.java, so documentation only (see NOTES). Align 'C, N' -> C.
unmapped: Disintegration ray, 6" range, 3/day (listed but inert).
Many robots fly instead of having the ray.
Cannot be subdued.

monsters.name: Young Roc
notes: Stats from Table 3.12; Number/Lair/Treasure/Align from the summary. Move 6/48 -> MV 6, Flight (48).
unmapped: Always spots hidden (not invisible) man-types, so master's Detection (which is about invisibility) is not used.

monsters.name: Ancient Roc
notes: 'The largest rocs' force normal-types (under 3 HD) to check morale when attacked -> Fear (2) (Arena: enemies of HD 2 or less must save or flee).

monsters.name: Salamander
notes: AC 3/5: upper body AC 5, serpent section AC 3; a melee opponent fights the upper body, so 5 (as master Salamander). Weapon 1-6 plus 1-6 burning to non-fire creatures -> Dam 2d6. Constricts with burning tail on exceeds-by-4 for 2-12 (+1-6) -> Constriction (Arena: attaches on any hit and does half the attack routine per round). Invulnerable to fire and normal weapons -> FireImmunity, MagicToHit (1). Number 2-5 -> 1d4+1.
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4: constrict for 2-12 plus 1-6 (mapped to Constriction)
unmapped: Split AC: serpent section is AC 3 (Arena has one AC).

monsters.name: Giant Scorpion
notes: Pincer 3-8 -> 1d6+2. Stinger (fatal poison, save) only on exceeds-by-4 / 20 -> Poison; Arena's Poison fires on every hit, so this over-states the sting.
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4 / natural 20: stinger, save vs poison or die (mapped to Poison)

monsters.name: Leviathan
notes: Swallows a ship whole for 4-24 to all aboard -> Dam 4d6, Swallowing. Move '-/18' -> MV 0, Swimming (18).
unmapped: Capsizes 1-3 ships per turn.

monsters.name: Kraken
notes: 1-6 attack rolls of 3-18 -> Atk 4 (expected 3.5), Dam 3d6. Treasure G* -> G.
unmapped: Capsizes any ship in 1-2 turns.
Confined to a null dimension unless summoned.

monsters.name: Sea Serpent
notes: 2-12 and swallows whole 'as per purple worms' -> Dam 2d6, Swallowing.
unmapped: Encircles and destroys longboats in 1-6 turns.

monsters.name: Shadow
notes: Move '-/9' (incorporeal) -> MV 9 plus Flight (9). Silvered or magic weapons only -> SilverToHit. Drains 1-4 strength per hit -> StrengthDrain (Arena drains 1 point per hit). Not undead in DD, so Type B as master.
unmapped: Magic weapons do double damage.
Victims reduced to nil strength rise as shadows (master writes Spawn).

monsters.name: Skeleton
notes: Never checks morale -> Fearlessness (as master). Type U adds Undead.
unmapped: Unaffected by normal missiles.

monsters.name: Giant Viper
notes: DD's single 'Snakes, giant' row covers two sorts; split into Giant Viper (deadly venomous -> Poison) and Giant Constrictor Snake, like master's Giant Poisonous Snake / Giant Constrictor Snake.

monsters.name: Giant Constrictor Snake
notes: Bite is only 1-2 but the real attack is crushing for 2-12 per turn -> Dam 2d6 with Constriction (Arena applies half the attack routine per round to the constricted host).
monsters.trigger: surprise or exceeds-by-4: encircle and crush for 2-12 per turn (mapped to Constriction)
unmapped: Bite damage 1-2 when not constricting.
Encircles and destroys small boats.

monsters.name: Large Snake
notes: 50% are venomous -> Poison included (Arena has no 'half of them' idiom); strike it if you prefer the harmless half.

monsters.name: Spectre
notes: Move '-/15' -> MV 15, Flight (15). Impervious to normal weapons -> MagicToHit (1). Drains two levels -> EnergyDrain (2).
unmapped: Passes through walls.
Slain victims rise as spectre thralls (master writes Spawn).

monsters.name: Giant Spider
notes: Move 3/12 -> MV 3, WebMove (12) as master. Deadly venomous -> Poison. Webs equal to a web spell -> Webs: a SpecialType name but only implemented as a condition, so documentation only (see NOTES). Align C per summary.
unmapped: Web-spell webs around the lair (Webs listed but inert).
Ambush from hiding.

monsters.name: Large Spider
notes: Venomous with save at +2 -> Poison (2) (parameter is the target's save bonus, as master Large Spider).
unmapped: Secondary move 15 is scurrying over walls and ceilings.

monsters.name: Giant Squid
notes: AC 7/3 (not explained in DD; presumably body / tentacles) -> 7, as master Giant Squid. 1-6 attack rolls -> Atk 4. Move '-/12' -> MV 0, Swimming (12). Treasure A3 -> A.
unmapped: Split AC: second value 3 (Arena has one AC).
Ink cloud and triple-speed retreat (master writes InkCloud, Jet).
Grapple and capsize vessels.

monsters.name: Thull
notes: Regenerates 1 hp per turn -> Regeneration (1). Scratch paralyses normal man-types -> Paralysis.
unmapped: Elves immune to the paralysis.

monsters.name: Tiger
unmapped: Stalks to attack by surprise.

monsters.name: Titan
notes: Any two magic-user or cleric spells of each level per day -> bare Spells; Monster.java gives a monster named exactly 'Titan' two spells per level (d3+3 levels). Align 'Any' -> N. Treasure A1* -> A. DD gives no magic resistance, so master's MagicResistance (60) is not carried over.

monsters.name: Giant Toad
notes: 50% venomous -> Poison included (strike if preferred). Swallows only halflings and smaller, so Swallowing is not used against a human party.
monsters.trigger: exceeds-by-4: swallow halfling-sized or smaller (not mapped)
